# TODO v1 — greenfield E2E fixture

**Experimental implementation by the agent, not generated by SYNTH.** The synthetic test-operator contract is in `../TEST-OPERATOR-DECISION.md`.

Single-user, offline Node.js CLI. No accounts, sync, web UI, cloud deployment, or dependency installation.

```sh
node src/cli.js add "Buy milk"
node src/cli.js list
node src/cli.js edit 1 "Buy oats"
node src/cli.js done 1
node src/cli.js delete 1
npm test
```

The store defaults to `.todo-data.json` in the current working directory; set `TODO_DATA_FILE=/path/file.json` to choose another file. A corrupt file is never overwritten. Saving uses a same-directory temporary file and rename. This demo has no cross-process locking, backup, encryption, hosted deployment, or multi-user security.
